# Burton Snowboards

> > Burton Snowboards: Vermont-based snowboard manufacturer founded by Jake Burton Carpenter in 1977, featuring custom snowboards, outerwear, Step On bindings, and a global retail presence.

Burton is a pioneer in snowboarding culture and equipment, operating as a B Corp with flagship stores across North America and Europe. The company offers product customization through Burton Custom Shop, technical innovations like Step On boot-binding systems, and maintains a strong brand heritage rooted in Vermont craftsmanship.

## Key Topics

- Burton Snowboards
- Jake Burton Carpenter
- Donna Carpenter
- Step On bindings
- Vermont manufacturing

- [Jackets & Outerwear](https://burton.com/us/en/c/jackets): Jackets and outerwear category including insulated coats and shells
